name: stepper
blurb: Progress stepper component showing step states (active, completed, inactive, loading).
description: Composable stepper with Stepper, StepperItem, StepperTitle, StepperDescription, StepperIndicator, StepperTrigger, and StepperSeparator. Supports horizontal and vertical orientation, loading states, and click-to-navigate functionality via context.
use_when: Multi-step forms, wizards, or workflows where showing progress and allowing step navigation improves user experience.
avoid_when: Linear single-step flows where a progress bar suffices. Overkill for simple status indicators.
a11y: Supports click-to-navigate via keyboard. Proper ARIA roles for step items and context-based state management. Focus management delegated to parent.
